fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2026-07-04, around 12:25, a local agent allegedly encouraged Nandhini Kumari to deposit Rs. 5,000 on an online betting site, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-07-05. Bharathi Sri (9000000283) reported the matter for Nandhini Kumari, whose contact number is given as 9000000364. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100093. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Nithya Rani (9000000035) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Potentially relevant material referenced includes social media screenshots and a bank transaction reference.
